git_sha_note: HEAD of the worktree. probe_pool_depth.py, its receipt, capture and checkpoints are ALL UNTRACKED (git status '??'); no commit contains the tool. The receipt's git_sha therefore pins the pipeline code, not the probe.
bed_access: NONE. Not opened in any mode (a latency sweep was running against it). Every number here is recomputed from the capture sqlite (mode=ro), the checkpoint jsonl, the receipt rows, and the basis receipts.
kill_criterion: REFUTED if the ARM-1 pre-registered gate (>= 30 of 109 pool_absent misses with gold in the deep1000 pool) flips under an independent recomputation from the capture artifact, OR if deep_rank is shown to be something other than the shipped fused pipeline's published score map (different call path than the ladder, different read, or a truncation other than the two raised knobs), OR if the probe's shipped arm fails to reproduce the basis ladder's per-needle ranks. CORRECTED if the gate stands but a stated basis semantic, an attribution, or a headline reading is wrong or materially incomplete. CONFIRMED only if the gate stands, the basis is exactly what the receipt says, and no reading needs correction.
verdict_reason: The gate stands: 66/109 pool_absent gold found in the deep1000 pool, recomputed from the capture (0 discrepancies vs the receipt), shipped-arm ranks reproduce the 2026-08-28 ladder 216/216, and the call path / score read are identical to the ladder's. But the receipt's two 'basis semantics' are one predicate: on all 216 targets 'gold found in the deep1000 pool' <=> 'gold at raw BM25 proxy rank <= 1000' (0 mismatches) and 'gold in the shipped map' <=> 'BM25 proxy rank <= 50' (0 mismatches), because the FTS lane, the shortlist post-filter and the proxy build a byte-identical MATCH expression and the shortlist keeps exactly the BM25 top-N. The PASS is a raw-BM25-reach PASS; the fused pipeline contributes only the within-pool rank. Three further readings need correction: the admission-trace attribution (both knobs bind, 15/216 shipped maps are exactly 48 deep), the latency ratio (unpaired; paired median +264 ms, segment-1 +704 ms), and the burial of the load-bearing negative: the deep arm degrades gold rank for 40/41 near_band, 6/6 seat_capped and 23/60 hit controls, and its net delivery effect extrapolates to roughly -16 needles bed-wide.

identity_shipped_found_vs_bm25_le_50.note: no target has BM25 proxy rank 49 or 50, so on this data the shipped predicate is effectively BM25 <= 48 (the FTS lane depth); the two extra shortlist slots only ever hold tag-lane hits

recomputed.the_8_explanation: All eight sit at raw BM25 rank 59-500, i.e. outside the shipped 48/50 window, so the shortlist post-filter deleted them in the shipped arm; once admitted, RRF over the unbounded tag lanes lifts them into the head (bm25 89 -> fused 2; bm25 500 -> fused 19). Their deep scores are far above the shipped map's minimum score. Not tie-breaks, not term drift, not nondeterminism: the shipped arm reproduces the 08-28 ladder rank 216/216 and the terms table matches the pipeline's own query_terms (the TermCapture wrapper only ran on the deep arm and changed nothing).

deep_arm_delivery.bed_wide_extrapolation: hits lost 4/60 = 6.7% (Wilson 95% CI 2.6%-15.9%) of 314 hits = ~21 (8-50); misses rescued = 5 (all 156 misses were run, no extrapolation); net ~ -16 needles (roughly -3 to -45), delivered_gold_rate 0.668 -> ~0.63

latency.wall_vs_query_terms_n: p50 rises 7.6 s (10-19 terms) -> 28 s (60+ terms) identically in both arms: cost is the OR-joined term bag, not pool depth

controls.stratification: proportional to the HIT question_type mix (basic 22, semantic 8, project_related 8, ...), not the MISS mix (semantic 82/156 = 53%)
controls.found_60_of_60_is_guaranteed_by_construc: a hit has gold at shipped rank <= 12 => BM25 <= 48 => inside BM25 top-1000 => in the deep pool

attacks.attack: deep_rank is a raw BM25 depth-1000 ranking, not fused-pipeline admission
attacks.evidence: deep_rank IS the fused map (combine_rerank final over eligible_ids, published at knowledge_store.py:3987; same build_context(read_only, ignore_delivered, max_genes=12) call and same genome.last_query_scores read as ablation_ladder.py:1111/1151). But pool MEMBERSHIP at depth N is exactly BM25 top-N: FTS lane (:3195), shortlist (:3838-3868) and proxy build the identical MATCH string from the same query_terms; found_at_1000 <=> bm25_proxy <= 1000 with 0/216 mismatches. The two 'basis semantics' are one predicate.

attacks.attack: the 1000 map cap is a truncation other than the two knobs
attacks.evidence: combine_rerank returns the full final map (only ranked_ids is cut to limit); eligible_ids = shortlist set; FTS lane at 1000 returns BM25 top-1000; capture shows map_size exactly 1000 for 216/216.

attacks.attack: read_only / ignore_delivered / max_genes=K change the map
attacks.evidence: read_only only suppresses learning writes (and CYMATIX_DISABLE_LEARN=1); ignore_delivered acts at assembly, not scoring; max_genes=12 -> limit 24 -> auto FTS depth 48 in the shipped arm, overridden to 1000 in deep. Decomposition, cold tier and dense are all off in the toml, so a single query_docs call publishes the map.

attacks.attack: the admission-trace conclusion 'floor is bm25_shortlist_size=50, NOT fts5_candidate_depth=48'
attacks.evidence: 15/216 shipped maps are exactly 48 deep (FTS depth binding, tag lanes did not cover BM25 ranks 49-50); 62 are 49 and 139 are 50 (shortlist binding). Gold presence in the shipped map <=> BM25 <= 48 on this data. Both knobs bind; the practical conclusion (move both) stands.

attacks.attack: hit controls not stratified / not fixed-seed / not drawn from the basis hits
attacks.evidence: pick_controls reproduced exactly from seed 20260901 (largest-remainder allocation over hit question_type); 60/60 are ladder delivered_gold==1; 0/156 misses are. A miss-matched control would carry ~32 semantic instead of 8; semantic controls shifted median +1 vs 0, none lost, so the reading would not flip -- but the 60/60 found rate is tautological.

No git evidence exists (tool untracked). The criterion string is byte-identical in the earliest smoke receipt (HEAD 3ad934c) and every later one; script mtime 13:31:48 precedes the first deep segment 13:35:54. Weakest acceptable form of pre-registration.

attacks.attack: 8 pool_absent at deep rank <= 48 is impossible under a 50-deep shipped map
attacks.evidence: All 8 have BM25 proxy rank 59-500 (> 50) and 0 gold in the shipped capture pool: the shortlist deleted them; RRF over the unbounded tag lanes lifts them once admitted. Shipped arm reproduces the ladder 216/216, so no nondeterminism or term drift.

attacks.attack: latency: 3% unpaired p50 delta on a 19 s baseline, mixed cache states, resumed arm
attacks.evidence: Paired per-needle: median +264 ms (+1.4%); segment 1 (cold start) +704 ms / ratio 1.068, segment 2 +137 ms / 1.009; deep faster on 64/216. Wall is driven by query_terms_n (7.6 s -> 28 s) identically in both arms. The probe's shipped baseline matches the 08-28 ladder on the same 216 (19.5 s vs 18.7 s). Depth is cheap RELATIVE to a 19 s/query baseline that production would not accept; the number says nothing about absolute production cost.

attacks.attack: the 'side observation' is the real result
attacks.evidence: Deep arm moves gold DOWN for 40/41 near_band (median +5, max +27, 0 better), 6/6 seat_capped, 23/60 hits; delivers +5 misses (2 pool_absent, 3 seat_capped at deep rank 12) and loses 4/60 hits; bed-wide net ~ -16 needles (95% CI roughly -3 to -45). A straight 1000/1000 flip is predicted net-negative at rrf_k=20.

licenses: Keeps alive only the narrow claim that 66/109 pool_absent gold is lexically reachable at BM25 depth 1000 (104/109 at 20000). Does NOT license a candidate-depth A/B as a delivery lever: the deep arm itself measured admission widening as net-negative, and the semantic pool_absent gold that is reachable sits at fused rank > 200. Any density-at-admission arm must show a scorer that lifts BM25-rank-100-1000 gold past ~950 new competitors without the head dilution measured here, and must be paired against the 08-28 ladder with rloss.py, quoting n_paired.
